attempts.hypothesis: Repeated movement-stalled replans are caused by an approach reservation that should be released on the same stalled reason.
attempts.modification: Broadened the existing approach-reservation release condition for exit-gate movement stalls.

attempts.hypothesis: The stalled passenger is missing a one-step goal-region route after the recovery path is cleared.
attempts.modification: Added a one-step target route fallback after exit-gate recovery when the goal-region route is empty.

attempts.hypothesis: The retry loop repeatedly reselects a physically blocked exit lane; a least-loaded selection on the stalled recovery path may break the cycle.
attempts.modification: On exit-gate movement stalls, selected the least-loaded selectable lane by approach-slot availability, then queue length and stable facility id.

final_attempt3.decision: DEBT-2 remains above the unchanged one-percent criterion after the three-attempt timebox and is downgraded to known_limitation; no Round29 engineering search is authorized without a new observed failure mechanism.
